scenarios.scenario_abstract: With one hundred dollars fixed for glasses used only at a computer, [X] reserves the budget for prescription clarity, anti-reflection, low weight, and desk comfort rather than an outdoor-only protective feature.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为只在电脑前使用的眼镜设定一百美元总预算后，[X]会把预算用于处方清晰度、减少反光、轻量和桌前舒适，而不加入仅服务户外暴露的紫外线防护。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a several-hour late-April Table Mountain ascent that moves between exposed slopes, cloud breaks, summit wind, and a cable-car descent, [X] requires sunglasses with verified UV protection rather than relying on darkness of tint.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 四月下旬进行数小时桌山攀登、途中经过暴露山坡、云层间隙、山顶大风并乘缆车下山时，[X]会要求太阳镜具有明确的紫外线防护，而不以镜片颜色深浅代替验证。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: During spring city walks, a Calanques boat trip, and a short coastal trail, [X] keeps UV-protective sunglasses accessible for prolonged daylight and reflected sea light even when wind, shade, and showers alternate.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 春季进行城市步行、卡朗格乘船和海岸短途徒步时，[X]会让具有紫外线防护的太阳镜保持随手可取，以应对长时间日照和海面反光，即使海风、阴影和阵雨会交替出现。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: On a guided Mount Etna day that may cross exposed snow, lava fields, and high-altitude open ground, [X] brings UV-protective sunglasses while treating particle goggles as separate ash protection.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在可能经过暴露积雪、熔岩地和高海拔开阔地的埃特纳火山向导活动中，[X]会携带具有紫外线防护的太阳镜，同时把防颗粒护目镜视为另一项火山灰防护。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For an orchard treatment deliberately scheduled after pollinators leave in late evening, [X] uses clear goggles whose job is protecting the eyes from spray and branches and does not make UV protection a requirement for this after-daylight task.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在授粉者离开后的傍晚进行果园喷洒时，[X]会使用以防喷雾和树枝碰撞为核心的透明护目镜；这项任务在日照结束后进行，因此不把紫外线防护列为必需条件。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: On a mid-April family route through white-walled towns and remaining mountain snow, [X] packs children's sunglasses specifically for prolonged reflected outdoor light despite cold and cloudy weather.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 四月中旬带孩子经过白墙城镇和仍有残雪的山区时，[X]会专门准备具有紫外线防护的儿童太阳镜，应对即使天气寒冷多云仍会持续出现的户外反射光。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For an early shore-fishing session on Alexandria's rocks and harbor walls, [X] requires sunglasses with verified UV protection for sustained direct and reflected sunlight, independently of the separate polarization decision.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 清晨在亚历山大礁石和港墙边长时间垂钓时，[X]会要求太阳镜具有明确的紫外线防护，以应对直射和水面反射日光，并把偏光作为另一项独立判断。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: [X] keeps one familiar corrective pair dedicated to reading, dim classrooms, phones, and computer work, and handles bright outdoor physical education with a separate protective pair rather than adding an outdoor feature to the indoor pair.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: [X]把一副熟悉的近视矫正眼镜固定用于阅读、昏暗课堂、手机和电脑，并为明亮的户外体育课另配防护眼镜，而不让这副室内用镜承担紫外线防护。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While removing bathroom-ceiling mold, [X] chooses clear indoor safety goggles for upward visibility and chemical splash coverage, excluding an irrelevant UV feature from the dedicated task equipment.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 清理浴室天花板霉菌时，[X]会选择保证向上视野并防化学飞溅的透明室内护目镜，不在这件专用任务装备上加入无关的紫外线防护。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For indoor concrete drilling, [X] selects clear safety glasses that preserve pencil marks and tool alignment while blocking particles, with no UV feature added to this strictly indoor role.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在室内混凝土墙上钻孔时，[X]会选择既能挡住颗粒又能看清铅笔标记和工具校准的透明安全眼镜，不为这一纯室内用途加入紫外线防护。
